classification: invalid benchmark methodology: managed loader was not admitted by the thin protocol client

cause.native_protocol: With --loader-managed, begin_stage requests a loader pause and emits loader_stage. The client must perform memory/thread admission and send loader_resume or loader_deny.
cause.thin_client_mismatch: The original thin Service client sent solve requests but did not implement the production admission/resume handshake. Merely copying the production native flags does not implement its managed-loader client.
cause.resulting_behavior: All recorded requests exhausted the bounded base proof window and spent nearly the rest of the deadline waiting for strong. Strong and Tail were never adopted, so the late-Tail variant was never exercised.

interpretation_limits: These timeouts do not establish a production strong-loading regression or real end-to-end solver performance.
Zero late-Tail improvements in this attempt do not establish that the implemented late-Tail improver lacks a benefit; the attempt count was also zero.
The original failures array is empty because this partial collection did not diagnose the protocol mismatch. It is not a passed benchmark or a completed AB/BA/AB matrix.
Do not merge this attempt into valid AB summaries, adoption medians, PAR-2 means, or the final 72-request matrix. Retain it as a failed experiment record.

replacement_method.deadline: Set deadline once to the measured request start plus 30 seconds. The production bridge includes startup and admission, forwards only remaining time to native search, and retains its cancellation watchdog.
replacement_method.loader: Use the production reader dispatcher and _admit_loader_locked for real memory/thread admission. Record diagnostics.service_events and the actual asset_ready/asset_adopted frames.
replacement_method.isolation: Release the native process before each measured request. Use the same binary, frozen state, total 15-thread quota, staged default flags, and AB/BA/AB order; change only late-tail-improvement off/on.
replacement_method.validation: Independently validate every candidate and terminal formula, including formulas returned in timeout frames, and recompute QTM cost. Count strict success only within the original request deadline.
replacement_method.state: The replacement was statically reviewed. This record does not claim that its real engine run or its AB matrix has passed.
